<script setup lang="ts">
import { type HTMLAttributes, provide } from "vue";
import { cn, paginationRootVariants } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PaginationContextKey } from "./pagination-context";
import { usePagination } from './use-pagination';

const props = defineProps<{
  id?: string;
  page?: number;
  defaultPage?: number;
  pageSize?: number;
  defaultPageSize?: number;
  count?: number;
  siblingCount?: number;
  boundaryCount?: number;
  class?: HTMLAttributes["class"];
}>();

const emit = defineEmits<{
  (e: "update:page", value: number): void;
  (e: "update:pageSize", value: number): void;
  (e: "change", value: { page: number; pageSize: number }): void;
}>();

const api = usePagination(props, emit);
provide(PaginationContextKey, { api });
</script>

<template>
  <nav
    role="navigation"
    aria-label="pagination"
    :class="cn(paginationRootVariants(), props.class)"
    v-bind="api?.getRootProps?.()"
  >
    <slot />
  </nav>
</template>

<view class="{{className}} pagination">
  <!-- Previous Button -->
  <view 
    class="pagination-btn pagination-prev"
    bindtap="onPrevTap"
    data-disabled="{{!api.previousPage}}"
  >
    <text>上一页</text>
  </view>

  <!-- Page Numbers -->
  <view class="pagination-pages">
    <block wx:for="{{api.pages}}" wx:key="index">
      <view 
        wx:if="{{item.type === 'page'}}"
        class="pagination-page"
        data-page="{{item.value}}"
        data-current="{{item.value === api.page}}"
        bindtap="onPageTap"
      >
        {{item.value}}
      </view>
      <text 
        wx:elif="{{item.type === 'ellipsis'}}"
        class="pagination-ellipsis"
      >
        ...
      </text>
    </block>
  </view>

  <!-- Next Button -->
  <view 
    class="pagination-btn pagination-next"
    bindtap="onNextTap"
    data-disabled="{{!api.nextPage}}"
  >
    <text>下一页</text>
  </view>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-content">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-ellipsis" aria-hidden="true">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<view class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-item">
  <slot></slot>
</view>

<button class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-link" aria-current="{{active ? 'page' : ''}}">
  <slot></slot>
</button>

<button class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-next" aria-label="Go to next page">
  <slot></slot>
</button>

<button class="{{className}}" data-slot="pagination-previous" aria-label="Go to previous page">
  <slot></slot>
</button>
